result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** as the best overall project management tool, particularly if you're building a tech product.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work.

My shortlist would be Linear, Notion, ClickUp, Asana, and Trello.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Projects – Linear Docs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/H7btCzSbelKXdMr_2WS3GWddG9qajBq9JZDHM8HYyOoLV6E4HDh5vlzogddffE6t5gTnGdoZ53UsXuMyPZWPmHRUwQ3ddApfS44CKAri923rLMIeylRQs9HZxmyB23G0rTfX3tmbKwJPdUtZW_x9bJsI8X8b5_Xrbg_k3vvdE22XkcL7igbp9gCGi9QLirCv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Great for engineering and product teams.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Integrates with GitHub and Slack.

Website: [linear.app](https://linear.app/)

---

![Personal Project Management Software by ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/_pr-XAvazbD79U9Fs1ZlLirWmUyP4twC_NSDH4BYVcebpfmnBiuDGOrk74CEjZs-oHz30-yI9sKsY1TbNYZRTNJWzphn7qw6XsyvH_qOFaIBsMTKjsKefmNUb_q_s56bTSGAe-cEgN6H7mENdhBlpnDOXge64OfaHlBNyO4WCRXhOhY-ARxWj3ogfIcI0JdG?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, documents, goals and dashboards.
- Good for marketing, operations and product.
- Highly customisable.
- Generous free plan.

Website: [clickup.com](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Project tracking and documentation together.
- Company wiki and knowledge base.
- Meeting notes and business plans.
- Flexible databases.

Website: [notion.com](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**
**Best for growing teams**

- Clear project ownership.
- Task dependencies and timelines.
- Good cross-team collaboration.
- Useful management reporting.

Website: [asana.com](https://asana.com/)

---

![How to Toggle Trello Views: Calendar, Table, Timeline & More](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Md351UxojPqr7NcZARTUVuAl7ocTctX4xXxse2slXCoIC1a14ed7C82Suo3_BLOf8uMvPvkR6a7txy4RworeyrfELrkzyRnZeSU5JT9wx8ysI4A-zP3PbB-iwMrUJ8znrFR0rgAWlJ-HP1EFK6mtsJMgFbfykp-Rc-ETfrBKJfKEo5IF5n0UcFY7ie8JejkV?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Trello**
**Best for simplicity**

- Very easy to learn.
- Visual Kanban boards.
- Minimal setup.
- Good for small founding teams.

Website: [trello.com](https://trello.com/)

## My recommendation by startup type

| Your startup | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| SaaS / technology | Linear |
| AI startup | Linear + Notion |
| General business startup | ClickUp |
| Consulting / services | ClickUp |
| Marketing / e-commerce | Asana |
| Very early-stage / bootstrapped | Notion |
| Small team wanting simplicity | Trello |


## What I'd actually set up

For an early-stage startup, I'd avoid overcomplicating things.

I'd start with\:

- **Notion\:** Company knowledge, strategy, meeting notes and documentation.
- **Linear or ClickUp\:** Execution, tasks, priorities and deadlines.
- **Slack\:** Team communication.

Don't buy five different tools when three will do.

## Let me narrow it down to the best one for your startup

There are three things I'd like to understand\:

**1\. What type of startup are you building?**

**3\. What's your biggest priority?**

---

**4\. What stage are you at?**

I'll use those answers to recommend one tool rather than give you another long list.
